capabilities: Show thoughts in a date-grouped timeline
Quote, copy, or link earlier thoughts
Filter thoughts by keyword or tag
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. Drafts are not saved across tab close or restart, so post before leaving. Migrating from the original Murmur: disable it and rename the Murmur/ folder to Murmline/. Timeline loads 50 entries at a time. Chinese interface settings show Simplified Chinese; other languages show English. Optional tipping via WeChat Pay or Alipay.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly jot short, timestamped thoughts into a single chronological timeline.
summary: Micro-journaling plugin that captures thoughts of up to 140 characters in a private, date-grouped timeline stored as Markdown files.
